events.title: A path for the rain
events.intro: Rain gathers beside the nursery beds. A small channel will give it somewhere to go.

before.speaker: Nursery keeper
before.line: See where the water stops? The leaves are resting in it. A little drainage will help more than another drink.

before.speaker: Nursery keeper
before.line: When the lettuce is ready, take three heads to the bistro. The host will be glad of something fresh on a rainy day.

after.speaker: Nursery keeper
after.line: The water has a way out now. Sometimes caring for a garden means making a little room.

after.speaker: Bistro host
after.line: And the lettuce reached the table. Even a rainy day can end with a good lunch.

events.title: A harvest remembered
events.intro: One lettuce can become a gift, a little saved for later, or coins for the farm.

before.speaker: Bistro host
before.line: A gift, something kept for later, or coins for your next planting. Which feels right for this harvest?

before.speaker: Bistro host
before.line: Make your choice with one lettuce, then come and tell me. I would like to remember it.

events.title: Our first meal
events.intro: The nursery keeper visits the bistro, and two tables meet in one kitchen.

before.speaker: Nursery keeper
before.line: The helpers at the nursery could use two carrots and one lettuce. I brought the basket here because I hoped to catch you.

before.speaker: Bistro host
before.line: There is also a place for your first salad at this table. A fresh carrot and a lettuce are all we need.

after.speaker: Bistro host
after.line: That first bowl tasted of your farm. I hope this is the beginning of many shared meals.

after.speaker: Nursery keeper
after.line: And the helpers have their lunch. What you grow is already finding its way around the neighbourhood.

events.title: Beyond the gate
events.intro: The nursery path is clear. There is time to see another farmer's garden before the first building materials arrive.

steps.label: A farm visit completed and returned

before.speaker: A note at the gate
before.line: The path is open. The keeper is tending seedlings today.

before.speaker: A note at the gate
before.line: Have a look around the other farms, then bring the first materials when they are ready. Nothing in the basket will spoil while you are away.

after.speaker: Your journal
after.line: Another garden, another way of arranging the same small patch of ground. I came home with ideas.

after.speaker: Your journal
after.line: The first materials are at the nursery, and the cleared path makes the old gate feel closer.

events.title: A gate for everyone
events.intro: The restorer arrives with two plans for the nursery gate. First, there are beds to shelter from the wind.

steps.label: The beds sheltered from the wind
Two carrots and four chamomile delivered

before.speaker: Restorer
before.line: This wind has found every loose board. Cover your beds, and I will take care of the gate.

before.speaker: Restorer
before.line: A row tool or another bed: both are useful, but you only need to choose the direction today. The work can wait until you have saved enough.

after.speaker: Restorer
after.line: The beds are sheltered, and you have a plan for your own farm. That is a good day's work.

after.speaker: Nursery keeper
after.line: When the last two carrots and four chamomile blooms have arrived, there will be a gathering at the courtyard.

gathering.speaker: Nursery keeper
gathering.line: Two carrots, four chamomile blooms, and a whole week's care. Every part of the basket has reached us.

gathering.speaker: Restorer
gathering.line: The gate is sound again. I left the old marks where I could; a repaired place should remember what came before.

gathering.speaker: Bistro host
gathering.line: I brought something for the table. From the first lettuce to the first salad, your farm has become part of our days.

gathering.speaker: Nursery keeper
gathering.line: Let us open this gate together. Then we can put the tools aside and gather for a photograph.

shared_harvest.title: A little kept for someone
shared_harvest.text: I began the week counting seeds. Somewhere between the first radish and the last lettuce, I began counting places at a table instead. Some of the harvest went into another person's hands; some stayed safely put for a later day. The farm grew, and so did the space I made for others.

familiar_faces.title: Names beside the gate
familiar_faces.text: The nursery keeper waits for rain to pass. The bistro host remembers what reaches the table. The restorer finds a second life in old wood. I know where to find them now. When we stood by the finished gate, the neighbourhood felt a little more like a place I belonged.

personalized.title: A week of sharing
personalized.text: The garden kept a little room for stories, and familiar faces gather around the finished gate.

standard.title: A week of growing
standard.text: The harvest helped the farm take its next step. The finished gate is open, and everyone is here to mark the week together.

next_week_clues.resident_seed_exchange: Next week: the nursery keeper has a seed exchange in mind, and a place saved for your story.
next_week_clues.nursery_next_stage: Next week: help plan the nursery's next planting beds. The gate is only the beginning.
